summary: Identifies the selected protection condition that permits carrier transmission.
description: Identifies the selected protection condition that permits carrier transmission. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Protection communication initiation” at the input and “Carrier transmit request” at the output. The receiving scheme defines the message meaning.
